svg.title: Wallet balances and money movement mobile flow
svg.desc: Six mobile mockups show the wallet list and balances, the contextual add-wallet action, wallet creation, adding money from an external source, reallocating money between wallets, and a wallet detail page with its recorded transactions.

g.text: Wallet balances are the primary view. Payday is a repeated top-up workflow, while reallocation is the same movement form with a tracked wallet as the source.
Incoming movements − outgoing movements − recorded expenses. No bank sync, opening-balance requirement, monthly plan, or global ledger view.
Balances from recorded funding and spending.
Shared savings for trips and bookings
Spending may make it negative. Record a money
movement whenever you want to track funding.
Connect budget lines from the Budgeting page.
One movement form handles both payday top-ups and reallocation between tracked wallets.
Record where tracked money comes from and goes.
Both tracked balances update from one movement.

Visual language follows the implemented React shell: Material UI surfaces, Inter, semantic teal/blue tokens, 44 px controls, adaptive bottom drawers, card-first mobile layouts, and the fixed launcher dock.
